symptom: 24 complete MDL examples in docs-site/src parsed but failed `mxcli check` (MDL020 CreatedDate, MDL021 Id/Type, MDL023 unseeded AutoNumber, MDL-WIDGET34 attributes outside a data container in snippets, MDL-SEC20, MDL-GRANT02 grant to a user role, MDL-PAGE01, MDL-ODATA05, MDL008); building the fixed examples with mxbuild 11.12.1 found three more the linter passes: the CRM validation microflow did not parse at all (`NOT contains(…)`), the CRM demo-user password broke the new-project 12-character policy, and the quick-reference published OData service had no KEY (CE6585, then CE6624/CE0309 until the key attribute is NOT NULL UNIQUE)
cause: docs-site was outside every semantic gate; a headerless complete script is indistinguishable from a fragment, so a parse error there reads as 'fragment' to both check-skill-mdl.sh (which skips microflows) and the semantic gate, and only the conformance gate's `mdl 1;`-header rule holds a block to parse
file: `docs-site/src/**` examples; gate scope in Makefile `check-skill-mdl` and push-test.yml
insight: Check-clean is not build-clean: after the linter was satisfied, one mxbuild run over the fixed examples found three more defects, one of them a block that never parsed. Exec every example from a page into ONE fresh project (`mxcli new … --skip-init`, exec each block, `docker check`) — it costs one build and catches what no per-block rule can (missing KEY, project password policy, cross-block param names like `VAL_Customer(param = …)`). Give each complete example an `mdl 1;` header: that is what makes the conformance gate hold it to parse. Side observation, fixed in the same PR: the CE0309 seen while iterating came from re-running `create or modify published odata service` after adding `(KEY)` — the stored non-key CanBeEmpty true was carried onto the new key (see 2026-10-09-odata-canbeempty-carried-onto-new-key-member.json), not from the entity's NOT NULL change
